reduce-to-circuit:
(program
  (kernel-declaration (%kernel.2 () (Kernel)))
  (public-ledger-declaration ((%calls.0 (0) (Counter))))
  (witness %secretKey.3 () (tbytes 32))
  (circuit %leakKey.1 () (tbytes 32)
    (= #t %t.5 (public-ledger %calls.0 (0) increment 1))
    (= #t %t.6 (call %secretKey.3)) %t.6))
